title: Secure your passport
description: Apply for or renew a passport valid for at least six months beyond your intake.

title: Sit the IELTS exam
description: Book and complete IELTS with a band score of 7.0 or higher.

title: Write your Statement of Purpose
description: Draft, review with your counsellor and finalise your SOP.

title: Collect Letters of Recommendation
description: Request two academic references and upload the signed letters.

title: Submit your applications
description: Complete and submit applications to every shortlisted university.

title: Pass the admission interview
description: Practise with the AI interview module, then attend the university interview.

title: Accept your offer
description: Review offer letters, compare conditions and confirm your place.

title: Apply for your student visa
description: Assemble financial documents and lodge the student visa application.

title: Prepare for departure
description: Book flights, arrange accommodation and complete pre-departure briefing.
